defects_found.description: The 95% CI for the headline difference on UNSOLVED problems is given as [+0.21, +0.36]. The artifact gives [+0.13, +0.36], so the lower bound is overstated; the interval nearly reaches the point estimate's neighbourhood of 0.24 only in the paper. results.tex also disagrees with claims.json.

defects_found.description: C3 selected problems include items duplicating problems already used earlier: apex-shortlist_25..28 duplicate aime_2025/hmmt_feb_2025 calibration problems, and smt_2025_42 duplicates an apex_2025 problem. All five are in the selected C3 set. C3 also draws on smt_2025, cmimc_2025, brumo_2025, apex_2025, hmmt_nov_2025 and arxivmath-0626, which the Method section lists as the screen split already judged by subjects. defects_found.location: Sec. 3.5: 'six monthly arXiv-derived sets from December 2025 to May 2026'; '13 competitions'
defects_found.description: The C3 selection contains seven arXiv-derived sets (arxivmath-1225, 0126, 0226, 0326, 0426, 0526, 0626), i.e. through June 2026, not six ending in May. The paper's 'held-out' arXiv sets (August and September 2026) are not in C3 at all.

defects_found.location: Sec. 4.5 / Conclusion: 'verification by sonnet removed none of the inflation'; Sec. 4.4 H3
defects_found.description: Only the haiku-pick direction is reported (d=+0.02, p=0.29). The pre-registered companion result for sonnet's picks has a Holm-free one-sided p=0.049 (d=+0.04) and is omitted; also H3 was declared inconclusive, so 'did not reduce' and 'removed none' overstates a null/inconclusive result.

AUROC 0.56 with CI [0.47, 0.65] includes 0.5, yet the text says decisiveness 'separated' TP from TA; the claim of 'little warning' is fine but 'separated' implies a detectable signal. Also the p2 pilot AUROCs 0.64/0.59 are cited as comparable without CIs.

defects_found.location: Sec. 4.6 Agreement and diversity (s10_hetero vs s10_homo)
defects_found.description: The claim that errors correlate less across models (0.54) than within one model (0.67) is presented without caveat, but the artifact notes that the bootstrap is over model pairs that share models and 'is descriptive, not a valid test'; the statistical unit is not problems.

defects_found.location: Sec. 4.6 Who&When: sonnet 'close to' the majority baseline
defects_found.description: Sonnet normalized hand-crafted accuracy is 0.57 versus majority baseline 0.53, i.e. above it, not merely close; haiku strict hand-crafted agent accuracy is 0.17 (far below baseline), which is not stated, only the post hoc normalized 0.43.

defects_found.location: Sec. 2 Related work, description of wang2025llms
defects_found.description: The paper attributes to Wang et al. (COLING 2025) specific analyses (isolated true/false verification of incorrect options, relation to choice, replaced-correct-option with a no-answer option). The citation evidence was obtained only from search snippets with pages blocked and supports only the 'least incorrect option / accuracy persists when correct option removed' claim, so the detailed characterization used to delimit novelty is unverified.
